programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: Moby Dick
programme.desc: El Pequod es un barco ballenero cuyo objetivo principal es cazar a la mítica ballena blanca. Al mando de la nave está el tiránico capitán Ahab, que vive obsesionado con la idea de capturar al animal que consiguió escapar después de arrancarle una pierna.

programme.title: Mentiras e ilusiones
programme.desc: Un novelista de éxito en el género policiaco y de espionaje es perseguido por un espía que, basándose en sus novelas, cree que tiene escondidos millones de dólares en diamantes, robados por su difunta prometida.

programme.title: El jaguar
programme.desc: Tres pintorescos personajes coinciden en el ascensor del gran hotel Crillon: un indio amazónico, su intérprete y un ciudadano francés, cuya vida cambia cuando el nativo lo reconoce como El Elegido.

programme.title: El último trabajo
programme.desc: Un anciano enfermo de cáncer busca vengarse de los ladrones que le destruyeron la vida.

programme.title: Soldado Universal 3: Regeneración
programme.desc: Un equipo de radicales de la ex Unión Soviética irrumpe en Chernóbil y amenaza con desatar una nube radiactiva 100 veces más letal que Hiroshima y Nagasaki juntas.

programme.title: Soldado Universal 4: El juicio final
programme.desc: Joe despierta de un coma meses después de que él y su familia fuesen brutalmente atacados. Para recomponer su vida y vengarse de los culpables, deberá enfrentarse a una milicia paramilitar de 'soldados universales'.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Operación Chuleta de Ternera
programme.desc: A Tiburón, capitán del servicio de espionaje francés, le encargan la operación Chuleta de Ternera. Su misión es desmantelar una red de tráfico de armas y vigilar una embajada extranjera que se sospecha que ha vendido los planos de un arma secreta.

programme.title: Moby Dick
programme.desc: El Pequod es un barco ballenero cuyo objetivo principal es cazar a la mítica ballena blanca. Al mando de la nave está el tiránico capitán Ahab, que vive obsesionado con la idea de capturar al animal que consiguió escapar después de arrancarle una pierna.

programme.title: El tutor
programme.desc: Exprisidario Ray Bradstone está tratando de encontrar un trabajo honrado. El jefe de una banda de ladrones de bancos le propone un último trabajo. Al principio acepta, pero cambia de opinión y decide acompañar a su hija a una excursión de la escuela.

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres. Pronto se embarcarán en una misión suicida para volar un puente.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Cuando le toman como rehén durante el atraco a un banco, un hombre se propone proteger a la guapa cajera de la que se ha enamorado perdidamente.

programme.title: Diferencias irreconciliables
programme.desc: Alternando entre el pasado y el presente, una niña precoz demanda a sus padres egoístas la emancipación, sorprendiéndolos a ambos.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Piranha Sharks
programme.desc: Mediante bioingeniería se ha conseguido reducir el tamaño de los grandes tiburones blancos al de las pirañas para adornar los exóticos acuarios.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro, el mejor cazatalentos de Los Ángeles, parece tenerlo todo: una carrera de éxito, dinero y una hermosa mujer. Pero se siente vacío y decide asistir a las clases de creación literaria del pomposo y temperamental sr. Primkin.

programme.title: Operación Chuleta de Ternera
programme.desc: A Tiburón, capitán del servicio de espionaje francés, le encargan la operación Chuleta de Ternera. Su misión es desmantelar una red de tráfico de armas y vigilar una embajada extranjera que se sospecha que ha vendido los planos de un arma secreta.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: Los Padecientes
programme.desc: Un thriller psicológico que gira en torno a una joven mujer que se enfrenta a oscuros secretos familiares, mientras su salud mental y su percepción de la realidad comienzan a desmoronarse.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: Teniente Corrupto
programme.desc: El teniente Terence McDonough, adicto a las drogas por sus dolores crónicos de espalda, investiga el asesinato de cinco inmigrantes senegaleses en Nueva Orleans.

programme.title: Amenazados
programme.desc: Thriller psicológico que gira en torno al interrogatorio, por parte de un agente del FBI, a un sospechoso de terrorismo para que confiese la ubicación de tres bombas nucleares preparadas para detonar en los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Los amos de Brooklyn
programme.desc: Tres policías (Richard Gere, Ethan Hawke y Don Cheadle), con carreras muy diferentes entre sí, coincidirán durante una redada en la zona más peligrosa de Brooklyn. Del director de la saga Equalizer y guionista de Training Day, Antoine Fuqua.

programme.title: 23-F: El día más difícil del Rey
programme.desc: El 23 de febrero de 1981, un grupo de mandos militares encabezados por Antonio Tejero perpetraron un intento de golpe de Estado durante la votación del candidato a la presidencia del Gobierno, Leopoldo Calvo Sotelo, en el Congreso.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: La Mirada
programme.desc: Dramaturga duda entre manipulación y perder la realidad.

programme.title: Hierro 3
programme.desc: Tae-suk, que okupa casas, encuentra a Sun-hwa, maltratada por su marido. Ella se une a su vida errante hasta que son descubiertos. Tras ser encarcelado, él la busca para recuperarla.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: El equipo responde a un coche sospechoso que sigue a una furgoneta blindada. Michael va en contra del procedimiento operativo estándar y se enfrenta a los ladrones sin ayuda.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 11
programme.desc: Un incidente en una estación de servicio lleva al equipo a dar con un ex soldado del SAS con vínculos con un grupo terrorista. Cuando intenta robar un camión farmacéutico, 'Tactical Response' une fuerzas con 'Major Crime' para derribarlo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Cuando secuestran a un bebé, Lawson corre para encontrar a los secuestradores antes de que el abuelo del niño, una figura criminal conocida, los encuentre primero.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Cuando un taxista asalta a Shannon, 'Tactical Response' vincula el incidente con una serie de ataques contra mujeres. Mientras el equipo busca al conductor, Josh lucha por contener su ira.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Lawson extrae a una agente encubierta de un sindicato de drogas solo para descubrir que ha cruzado la línea y está embarazada de un criminal conocido. 'Tactical Response' corre para localizarla antes de que su novio descubra que es policía.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Lawson, Shannon y Stella corren para salvar las vidas de los estudiantes universitarios cuando dos adolescentes se desmadran en un campus universitario.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Stella queda atrapada en el fuego cruzado cuando un informante es retirado de la protección de testigos contra su voluntad.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Michael y Josh chocan cuando tratan con un hombre delirante. El equipo se apresura a detener a una mujer de asesinar a su esposo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Lawson y Josh se pelean cuando Lawson descubre la relación de Josh con Shannon. Mientras tanto, 'Tactical Response' rastrea a un criminal que ha escapado de prisión, y del cual Josh ha estado intentando demostrar que ha sido encarcelado injustamente.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 19
programme.desc: Lawson intenta salvar a Caleb de una vida de crimen, solo para descubrir que ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras tanto, la vida hogareña de Dom se acaba cuando la depresión de Sandrine amenaza con dañar a su bebé.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Una discusión sobre el cumpleaños de Kerry lleva a una apuesta sobre quién del el equipo tendrá relaciones sexuales con ella. Mientras tanto, Leon investiga una serie de robos de tiendas de videos, solo para encontrarse atrapado en un robo él mismo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: El equipo ayuda a eliminar a las niñas menores de edad de una comunidad donde se han realizado informes de comportamiento inapropiado.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Stella choca con Lawson mientras el equipo espera el informe balístico sobre el tiroteo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Después de rescatar a dos niños, la ira de Josh se derrama sobre su padre, quien puede haber intentado matarlos. El nuevo inspector desafía la posición de Josh en el equipo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Cuando dos adolescentes enamorados son perseguidos hasta un tejado y amenazan con suicidarse, Grace asume el cargo de negociadora principal, pero pronto se revela su inexperiencia.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 4
programme.desc: La Unidad de Respuesta Táctica persigue a un criminal que ataca a Grace mientras escapa. Josh permite que lo tomen como rehén. El criminal obliga a Josh a participar en un sádico juego de ruleta rusa.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 5
programme.desc: El equipo de Tactical Response se enfrenta a una situación peligrosa cuando un robo a mano armada se convierte en un asedio con rehenes en un pub suburbano. Lawson y Josh sorprenden a los ladrones y les disparan cuando llegan al pub.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Grace, Josh y Dom están investigando un ataque de activistas en un laboratorio de investigación cuando estallan bombas incendiarias, poniendo en riesgo sus vidas. Stella descubre que su hermano, que también es policía, es corrupto.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de un político prominente y su amiga de la escuela son secuestradas, Kerry y el equipo de Respuesta Táctica deben realizar una operación encubierta para recuperar a las niñas de manera segura.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Después de interrumpir un robo de autos en Lawson, Stella y Dom descubren un sindicato ilegal de renacimiento de vehículos, pero su sospechoso huye y Lawson lidera una persecución de autos cargada de adrenalina.

programme.title: El porvenir
programme.desc: Nathalie enseña Filosofía en un instituto de París. Su trabajo le apasiona y disfruta con la reflexión. Un día, su marido le dice que la deja por otra mujer. Con tanta libertad, Nathalie se ve obligada a reinventar su vida.

programme.desc: Thia, una ejecutiva dedicada a su trabajo, comienza una repentina relación amorosa con un constructor, aficionado a la escalada que se rinde a sus encantos.

programme.desc: Junio de 1940. En la Francia ocupada por Alemania, el joven polaco Jan Zumbach se hace pasar por un viajante de relojes suizo para conseguir llegar a un aeródromo.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: Simple men

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, "The Best Is Yet To Come," "Fly Me to the Moon," and his signature song "I Left My Heart in San Francisco."

programme.title: Herbie Hancock
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.desc: Based on the bestselling novel by M.L. Stedman and from acclaimed director Derek Cianfrance, The Light Between Oceans is a beautiful and heart-breaking reminder of the infinite power of love and the lengths that we'll go to in order to protect it.

programme.title: Don't Say A Word
programme.desc: When Dr. Nathan Conrad's daughter is kidnapped, a secret held by one of his catatonic patients may be his only hope.

programme.title: The Burial
programme.desc: When a handshake deal goes sour, a funeral home owner enlists a charismatic attorney to help save his family business. Tempers flare and laughter ensues as the unlikely pair bond while exposing corporate corruption and racial injustice.

programme.title: Arctic Blast
programme.desc: When a solar eclipse sends a colossal blast of super chilled air towards the earth, it then sets off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new Ice Age.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A suburban father and husband embraces a life of crime in order to support his family. Desperate times call for desperate measures.

programme.title: The Satanic Rites of Dracula
programme.desc: In 1974, Professor Lorrimer Van Helsing investigates a satanic cult on behalf of Scotland Yard, only to discover a plot by Count Dracula to commit global genocide. A.K.A. Count Dracula and his Vampire Bride

programme.title: Operation Overlord
programme.desc: A week before the Normandy landings, two American soldiers sneak into a deserted facility to save a POW from the Germans.

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: Lonely Maiden Productions, LLC. All Rights Reserved. Under exclusive license to Signature Entertainment Ltd 2008

programme.title: Redemption (2013)
programme.desc: Ex-soldier Joseph Smith comes home from war but has been left disturbed by his experiences. Despite his intentions to start a new life, he becomes caught up in the criminal underworld, where he plots revenge on his friend's killer.

programme.title: Trespass (2011)
programme.desc: When a group of cold-blooded criminals led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn) and Jonah (Cam Gigandet), invade the Miller mansion in a vicious home invasion, Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) must battle his personal demons before saving his wife and daughter.

programme.title: Dont Say A Word
programme.desc: When Dr. Nathan Conrad's daughter is kidnapped, a secret held by one of his catatonic patients may be his only hope.

programme.title: Bend It Like Beckham
programme.desc: Jess does not want to settle down. She wants to show the world how great of a soccer player she is.

programme.title: Dirty Girl
programme.desc: Rebellious 80s high school student Danielle runs away to find her birth father.

programme.title: LOL
programme.desc: Anne deals with life as a working mother and raising a teen who seems to be growing up faster than expected.

programme.title: The Duff
programme.desc: A high school senior instigates revolution after finding out she's the DUFF - Designated Ugly Fat Friend.

programme.title: Wild Oats
programme.desc: Everything changes for Eva when she receives a life insurance check accidentally made out for five million dollars instead of the expected fifty thousand dollars. She and her best friend take the money and head out for the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: The Furnace
programme.desc: Set in the 1890s gold rush of Western Australia and starring David Wenham (300), Jay Ryan (IT: Chapter 2), Mahesh Jadu (The Witcher) and Baykali Ganambarr (The Nightingale). To escape a harsh existence, a young Afghan cameleer partners with a mysterious bushman on the run with two 400oz Crown-marked gold bars. Together they must outwit a zealous police sergeant in a race to reach a secret furnace.

programme.title: Samurai Marathon
programme.desc: From the team behind 13 Assassins this sword slasher is inspired by a real-life race! In the late feudal era of Japan, a young ninja is operating undercover in the court of an ageing Lord. When the Lord challenges his lazy samurais to a punishing marathon, the ninja's loyalties are put to the test. Directed by Bernard Rose (Candyman) and boasting a breath-taking Philip Glass soundtrack.

programme.title: Beyond Suspicion
programme.desc: Ready to right some old wrongs in this edge-of-your-seat revenge thriller. When a drug bust goes wrong, notorious ex-cop Danny Gallagher's (Karl Urban: The Lord of the Rings) quest for justice leads him to the car-bomb murder of a government official's wife. Discovering the woman's secret lover was a seductive federal agent (Sofia Vergara: Modern Family), he finds himself under fire. But from who?

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: One night in 1990s rural England, a retired couple finds their isolated house besieged by a gang of young criminals. The thieves think it will be easy to make them give up the secret of their safe. But they have no idea what nightmare they've gotten themselves into as they fight to escape the house alive.

programme.title: Message Man
programme.desc: The Expendables meets Rambo: First Blood. A slick slice of action entertainment that blends old school action flair, with todays epic set pieces. Ryan is a retired hitman. His past is just that, in the past but sometimes trouble cannot be ignored. As a violent gang torments the local community, Ryan returns to his trade for one final killing spree where he becomes judge, jury and executioner.

programme.title: Love and Honor
programme.desc: While fighting in Vietnam, Dalton hears his girlfriend back home has dumped him. He has a week's leave coming up so decides to fly to get her back. AWOL from the war zone, he has seven days to get back to the US, change his girlfriend's mind and make it back to Vietnam without anyone noticing.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: Detachment
programme.desc: A substitute teacher who drifts from classroom to classroom finds a connection to the students and teachers during his latest assignment.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Emperor, the son of an African king and a slave on an American plantation, can no longer tolerate the atrocities committed by whites against blacks.

programme.title: Bliss
programme.desc: In this quirky love story, a divorced man meets a woman who is living on the streets and is convinced that the world around them is just a simulation.

programme.title: Blue Moon Ball
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Ashley Newbrough and Eric Lutz. While back in her hometown to finish her book, a novelist helps her ex save the town's historic ballroom - but can she write her own happy ending?

programme.title: A Pinch of Portugal
programme.desc: (2023) Culinary romance starring Heather Hemmens and Luke Mitchell. When a celebrity chef walks off his TV show, prep cook Anna steps into the lead role. But will she find love in the limelight?

programme.title: To England With Love
programme.desc: (2023) Rom-com with Georgia Hirst. Ali thinks life's perfect - until a historical treasure hunt in England turns her world upside down. Along the way, she discovers her heart's ready for adventure.

programme.title: Love at the Lodge
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Megan Elizabeth Barker. Lawyer Emma is promised a promotion if she can persuade Liam to sell his family's country lodge. But is she about to have a conflict of interest?

programme.title: If I Stay
programme.desc: A chronicle of a fatal car accident involving 17-year-old musician Mia and her boyfriend.

programme.title: Tennessee Williams' The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
programme.desc: After moving to Rome, a lonely widow finds herself consumed by a destructive love for a young Italian man in this adaptation of Tennessee Williams' haunting novella.

programme.title: Accidental Love
programme.desc: A small town waitress gets a nail accidentally lodged in her head causing unpredictable behavior that leads her to Washington, D.C., where sparks fly when she meets a clueless young senator who takes up her cause - but what happens when love interferes with what you stand for?

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees
programme.desc: When mill worker Lydia is abandoned by her philandering husband, she struggles to look after herself and her son Charlie. Local doctor Jean is one of the few to help and a friendship develops that blossoms into a romance that will scandalise the town.

programme.title: The Decoy Bride
programme.desc: A heart-warming romantic comedy about an ordinary girl who is hired to be the decoy for the most famous bride in the world.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Marilyn Hotchkiss Ballroom Dancing & Charm School
programme.desc: A widowed man's life turns upside down when he embarks on a journey to find a dying man's long lost love.

programme.title: For The Love Of Grace
programme.desc: After Grace Harding is saved from a fire by Steve Lockwood, a widowed firefighter, they teach each other to embrace life as they fall in love.

programme.title: Ruling of the Heart
programme.desc: Judge Morgan has become known for his no-nonsense toughness in court. He rules fast and he rules hard, barely noticing the person on the other end of his decisions. When he gets stuck in a cafe during a snowstorm, he is surprised to discover two of the other customers stranded with him happen to be people recently in his court, with verdicts handed down that have made him very unpopular. As the night unfolds in the small cafe, unexpected truth emerges from both sides that changes everything.

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: When Allie left her small town to move to San Francisco to pursue her dream of becoming a fashion designer, little did she imagine that the city had big plans for her - and for her heart.

programme.title: Midway to Love
programme.desc: When the network announces that her television therapy show is changing to a tabloid shock-fest, a straight laced and caring psychologist returns to her hometown and reunites with her high school sweetheart while finally realizing that having someone to share a life with is more important than fame and the excitement of the city.

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Snowed Inn Christmas
programme.desc: Jenna Hudson and Kevin Jenner are polar opposites.

programme.title: Steppin' Into the Holiday
programme.desc: Billy returns to his hometown and helps revive the town's Christmas Eve show.

programme.title: Delivering Christmas
programme.desc: Lonely mailman Tom likes single mom Lauren, unnoticed amid her holiday grief.

programme.title: Kirk Franklin's The Night Before Christmas
programme.desc: Journee and Nia are caught in a snowstorm and they take refuge inside a church.

programme.title: Sohla Cooks a 1,000-Year-Old Hangover Cure
programme.desc: Sohla travels back to the Islamic Golden Age of 10th century.

programme.title: Snowed Inn Christmas
programme.desc: Jenna Hudson and Kevin Jenner are polar opposites.

programme.title: The Love Club: Lauren
programme.desc: Lauren faces divorce papers but has a feeling that it's not quite over, so she asks the Love Club for help.

programme.title: Love's Sweet Recipe
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a talented chef and her childhood best friend as she regains her passion for cooking.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a TV show host and her colleague when they become the unexpected guardians of a baby.

programme.title: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Astaroth is back and possesses Coreen's body in an attempt to get closer to Vicki.

programme.title: New Dogs, Old Tricks
programme.desc: Sarah searches for her missing roommate. Jay endures Pete's revenge as Kappa Psi sisters prep for Gamma Fair.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Ninja
programme.desc: A well-meaning but hopelessly inept ninja ventures to the Hills of Beverly to rescue a mysterious beauty.

programme.title: You Don't Mess With The Zohan
programme.desc: A Mossad agent fakes his death so he can re-emerge in New York City as a hair stylist.

programme.title: Moms' Night Out
programme.desc: All Allyson and her friends want is a peaceful, grown-up evening of dinner and conversation... a long-needed moms' night out. But in order to enjoy high heels, adult conversation and food not served in a bag, they need their husbands to watch the kids for a few hours - what could go wrong? Moms' Night Out is an endearing, true-to-life family comedy.

programme.title: Holmes And Watson
programme.desc: A humorous take on Arthur Conan Doyle's classic mysteries featuring Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson.

programme.title: Made In America
programme.desc: When Zora Mathews goes searching for her biological, anonymous sperm donor father, she and her Afro-centric mother Sarah are dumbfounded to discover Hal Jackson, an obnoxious used car salesman on late-night TV and worse than that, he's white.

programme.title: Somebody I Used To Know
programme.desc: On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally spends a whirlwind night with her ex-boyfriend Sean which makes her question all the past choices she's made. Ally decides she has to Sean back...which gets much more complicated when she meets his fiancé.

programme.title: Gloria Bell
programme.desc: Gloria (Julianne Moore) is a free-spirited divorcée who spends her days at a straight-laced office job and her nights on the dance floor, joyfully letting loose at clubs around Los Angeles. After meeting Arnold (John Turturro) on a night out, she finds herself thrust into an unexpected new romance.

programme.title: The People We Hate at the Wedding
programme.desc: Dysfunctional American siblings Alice and Paul -- along with their ever-optimistic mom-- are invited to the British wedding of their estranged half-sister, Eloise, as a chance for them to reconnect as – more or less – adults, and learn to love each other like they once did.

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: After Dan Hogan and his gang rob a bank, they hire a mysterious man to guide them across the Mexican border in return for half of the loot.

programme.title: The Desperado Trail
programme.desc: After the Civil War, renegade Rollins and his gang provoke conflict between settlers and Native Americans. Winnetou and Old Shatterhand struggle to keep the peace, but Winnetou is framed for the murder of a tribal chief's son. Old Shatterhand must uncover the truth before war erupts.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: In 1906, on Oklahoma's Indian lands, a cowboy fights for oil lease rights against a greedy oilman while a pretty schoolteacher steals both men's hearts.

programme.title: London Town
programme.desc: Jerry has been promised a part in a London show, so he packs up and moves there with his daughter.

programme.title: Brighton Rock
programme.desc: Holidaymakers are awaiting the arrival of Kolley Kibber, who is working on a stunt for his newspaper.

programme.title: Hell is A City
programme.desc: Don Starling escapes from jail becoming England's most wanted man.

programme.title: Nowhere To Go
programme.desc: In London, a Canadian serving prison time for grand theft escapes prison and attempts to retrieve his loot.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are on a trip, so Claudia decides to help Sydney's friend Roger to find Julius Caesar's armor, but relic hunting is not her talent.

programme.title: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Working as consultants for an archeology adventure film, Sydney and Nigel realize the Pharaoh Amun II's props are genuine, long-thought lost relics. How can they be?

programme.title: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia discovers that she was Cleopatra's servant in a past life when she experiences déjà vu while watching a catalog from an Ancient Egyptian relics exposition.

programme.title: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney and her student Adam are onto his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee, but they are pursued by mysterious gunmen.

programme.title: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are ambushed in Russia. Two weeks later, Sydney wakes up in the house of a man called Tsarlov, who claims to have saved her.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney gets kidnapped, but by whom? Nigel, Claudia and Cate will have to go through the list of enemies Sydney has made in the past and deduce which of them is responsible. Cue flashbacks.

programme.title: Dont Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydney's friend phones to inform her that he's discovered information on the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since 1711. Sydney and Nigel travel to Lubjanka to meet him, but he's already gone.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: While on a lecture tour with Nigel in Europe, Sydney is contacted by MI5 because she is the only one who can prevent an impending high-level assassination.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: Two women become bank robbers to help the poor and seek revenge on a ruthless land baron.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story of America's most dangerous drug trafficker "La Barbie" Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, works with the Feliz brothers.

programme.title: Wire Room
programme.desc: Bruce Willis stars in this explosive thriller as a federal agent caught in chaos when a rookie in Homeland Security's Wire Room crosses a cartel arms dealer. With corrupt cops, a rogue guard, and a deadly SWAT team closing in, they must fight to survive and expose a conspiracy.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: In a visceral modern thriller from the director of Lone Survivor, Mark Wahlberg stars as James Silva, an operative of the CIA's most highly-prized and least-understood unit.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A symbologist is caught in an ancient web of secrecy and uncovers the truth about The Holy Grail.

programme.title: The Patriot (2000)
programme.desc: In 1776 South Carolina, widower Benjamin Martin (Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family being torn apart by the savage forces of the British Redcoats. When his oldest son's wife is ruthlessly killed, and his young son is shot through the back before his eyes, Martin is unable to suppress the soldier within that he tried to bury with his own military past. Unable to remain silent, he recruits a band of unlikely volunteers to take up arms against the British. Fighting to protect his famliy's freedom and his country's independence, Martin discovers the pain of betrayal, the redemption of revenge, and the passion of love.

programme.title: Fever Pitch [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A sports fan's romantic courtship clashes with his obsession with his favorite football team. Based on the book by Nick Hornby.

programme.title: Rush of Fear
programme.desc: Rosanna Arquette and Chris Potter star as couple Alex and Jack, who are away on a romantic weekend to try to salvage their broken marriage. Their trip turns into a nightmare when Jack is kidnapped.

programme.title: Husband for Hire
programme.desc: Lola must marry a man approved by her dad before her approaching birthday or she will lose her share of the family fortune. With Nadine Velazquez and Mario Lopez.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Doppelganger [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A writer with a room for rent acquires a strange new roommate with a psychotic alter-ego that follows her wherever she goes.

programme.title: Castle Falls [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive.

programme.title: Quicksand
programme.desc: Banker Martin Raikes heads to Monaco to investigate strange financial activity surrounding a film production that his bank is financing. There he encounters the film's star, the washed-up, hard-drinking one-time action star Jake Mellows. Before he can conduct a thorough investigation, Raikes finds himself framed for the assassination of a government official. With both crooks and the law out to get him, Raikes goes on the run, eventually hooking up with Mellows.

programme.title: Seconds to Spare
programme.desc: An assassin hijacks a passenger train and threatens to detonate enough poison to wipe out an entire city. While the cops attempt to thwart his ransom, they call in former DEA agent Paul Blake - the one man who may be able to stop the deadly plot.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Antibalas, Bettye LaVette, José James & Alice Russell
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx & Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella
programme.sub-title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, "The Best Is Yet To Come," "Fly Me to the Moon," and his signature song "I Left My Heart in San Francisco."

programme.title: Herbie Hancock
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Gianandrea Noseda, London Symphony Orchestra, Chris Richards & Rachel Gough
programme.sub-title: Gianandrea Noseda conducts Strauss and Liszt
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a concert performance recorded on April 15, 2021, at St. Luke's, London. The program begins with Richard Strauss's Duett-Concertino for clarinet and bassoon, a late, lyrical work that evokes a fairy-tale-like dialogue between the two solo instruments, featuring Chris Richards (clarinet) and Rachel Gough (bassoon). Next is Franz Liszt's Symphonic Poem No. 4, Orpheus, a contemplative and radiant homage to the mythic musician. The concert concludes with Nino Rota's Symphony No. 3, a richly melodic and rhythmically vibrant work that reflects the cinematic flair for which the composer is widely known.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Johnny Cash
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: En casa con Tori
programme.desc: Tori sorprende a su familia con una comida que los transporta a España.

programme.title: El viaje del emperador
programme.desc: Cada año, cientos de miles de pingüinos emperador abandonan la seguridad del océano para adentrarse en la desértica tierra helada de la Antártida. Marchan a través de este difícil paisaje de hielo conducidos por su necesidad de reproducirse con el fin de la supervivencia de la especie. Esta es la épica historia de una familia y su heroica lucha por sobrevivir.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: La familia Chase acaba de mudarse a una casa recién reformada. Pero su primera noche en ella se convierte en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Maurice
programme.desc: Gran Bretaña, principios de siglo XX. El joven Maurice se enamora de Clive, uno de sus compañeros de clase en la universidad. Juntos viven un romance que ambos mantienen oculto por su propia seguridad. Sin embargo, para sentar la cabeza y evitar las habladurías, Clive decide casarse con una joven. Maurice seguirá manteniendo relaciones secretas con otros hombres, aunque no serán lo mismo que con su primer amor.

programme.title: En busca del fuego
programme.desc: Hace ochenta mil años la Tierra estaba habitada por tribus primitivas cuya supervivencia dependía de un valioso tesoro: el fuego.

programme.title: Los Padecientes
programme.desc: Un thriller psicológico que gira en torno a una joven mujer que se enfrenta a oscuros secretos familiares, mientras su salud mental y su percepción de la realidad comienzan a desmoronarse.

programme.title: El secreto del lago
programme.desc: Un joven encuentra un inquietante secreto en un lago cercano a su casa, lo que provoca una serie de mentiras, sospechas y violencia entre los habitantes de la zona.

programme.title: El beso de la mujer araña
programme.desc: En una prisión sudamericana, Luis Molina (William Hurt) y Valentín Arregui (Raúl Julia) son compañeros de celda. Molina es un homosexual encarcelado por seducir a un menor. Valentín es un revolucionario de izquierdas torturado durante los interrogatorios.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: En este documental, Michael Moore examina el clima político y social de Estados Unidos, centrándose en los acontecimientos que llevaron a la elección de Donald Trump y en las consecuencias que tuvo para el país.

programme.title: Presa
programme.desc: Una veterinaria del zoo debe encabezar la caza de un monstruoso león que aterroriza la ciudad de Ámsterdam.

programme.title: Valkiria
programme.desc: En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial, un grupo de altos mandos alemanes desarrollan un plan para asesinar a Hitler.

programme.title: [•REC]
programme.desc: Un reportaje sobre unos bomberos se convierte en un infierno durante una intervención nocturna.

programme.title: Los Hijos de Allen Funt
programme.desc: Entre una habitación, cinco personas viven confinadas, con un obejtivo: salir al exterior.

programme.title: Oscuro deseo
programme.desc: Shane se obsesiona con la madre de su amigo muerto y trama adueñarse de todo.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: MARY SHELLEY desvela la historia de la joven Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin y su ardiente y tempestuosa relación con el poeta romántico Percy Bysshe Shelley. Ambos sienten un flechazo inmediato al conocerse y ante la oposición de la familia de Mary a su noviazgo, la pareja decide huir...

programme.title: El leñador
programme.desc: Joe Braven es un humilde leñador que vive en la frontera entre los Estados Unidos y Canadá. Cuando es asaltado por un grupo de traficantes de drogas en la recluida cabaña en el bosque donde vive, hará todo lo que está en su poder para intentar proteger a su familia.

programme.title: Prisioneros del Sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: Actos de violencia
programme.desc: Cuando su novia es secuestrada por una red dedicada al tráfico de personas, Roman MacGregor y sus dos hermanos, los tres exmilitares, deciden infiltrarse en la organización que la tiene secuestrada.

programme.title: Dark Was the Night
programme.desc: En el remoto pueblo de Maiden Woods comienzan a sucederse una serie de sanguinarios crímenes. Unas extrañas huellas parecen señalar a algún tipo de animal como principal sospechoso. Mientras la población vive atemorizada por los acontecimientos, el Sheriff Paul Shield investiga el caso.

programme.title: Y llovieron pájaros
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de tres ancianos que han elegido retirarse del mundo y vivir en los bosques de Canadá. Al tiempo que un gran incendio amenaza la región, alguien llega hasta su escondite.

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.title: El último verano
programme.desc: Anne, una brillante abogada que vive con su esposo Pierre y sus hijas, entabla gradualmente una relación apasionada con Theo, el hijo de Pierre de un matrimonio anterior, poniendo en peligro su carrera y su vida familiar.

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Un joven sin rumbo accede a entrenar a un equipo de las ligas menores del proyecto de viviendas Cabrini Green en Chicago como condición para obtener un préstamo de un amigo.

programme.title: Great Absence
programme.desc: Tras veinte años distanciado de su padre, una estremecedora llamada de la policía obliga a Takashi a volver a casa. La segunda esposa de su padre, Naomi, ha desaparecido y este se ha desconectado de la realidad.

programme.title: Una comedia romántica
programme.desc: Después de desaparecer durante la noche, un hombre reaparece y descubre que es el padre de una niña. Esta vez lo hará lo mejor que pueda.

programme.title: Lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Comedia dramática sobre dos profesores: él de inglés (Clive Owen) y ella de arte (Juliette Binoche), que sostienen dos puntos de vista diametralmente opuestos se enfrentan en una especie de batalla para dirimir si son más importantes las palabras o las imágenes y la chispa entre ellos se enciende..

programme.title: El fin del sexo (The End of Sex)
programme.desc: Una pareja que siente las presiones de la paternidad y la edad adulta envía a sus hijos a un campamento de invierno por primera vez y se embarca en una serie de aventuras sexuales para revitalizar su relación.

programme.title: Fiebre de boda
programme.desc: Dahlia Marchand, la más popular novelista romántica, le gusta ser casamentera, y está decidida a ayudar a su adorable editora a encontrar al "Señor Perfecto" para ella.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Brigitte, una actriz reconocida internacionalmente, llega a París para interpretar en una película a la icónica cantante francesa Barbara. A medida que pasan los días, la realidad y la ficción se irán confundiendo para el equipo de rodaje y también para la propia actriz.

programme.title: Lucky Luke
programme.desc: Durante su misión en Daisy Town, la ciudad que lo vio crecer, Lucky Luke, "el hombre que dispara más rápido que su sombra" se cruza con Billy el niño, Calamity Jane, Pat Poker, Jesse James y Belle. Su encargo es instaurar la paz en la ciudad.

programme.title: OSS 117: Perdido en Río
programme.desc: Doce años después de su estancia en El Cairo, OSS 117 tiene que cumplir una nueva misión. Siguiendo la pista de un microfilm comprometedor para Francia, el célebre agente forma equipo con una seductora teniente coronel del Mosad para capturar a un nazi chantajista. Esta aventura lo llevará de las soleadas playas de Río a los exuberantes bosques del Amazonas, de las más profundas grutas secretas a la cumbre del Cristo de Corcovado. Sea cual sea el peligro, siempre se puede contar con Hubert Bonisseur de la Bath para salir adelante.

programme.title: Mucho ruido y pocas nueces
programme.desc: Beatriz y Benedicto son dos jóvenes que no creen en los poderes del amor. Claudio, por el contrario, locamente enamorado de Hero, defiende el amor y desea casarse con ella por encima de cualquier cosa. Obsesionados con unir a Beatriz y Benedicto, la pareja y todos los que les rodean preparan un plan que intentará unirlos para siempre. Pero varios acontecimientos cómicos y trágicos se interpondrán en el camino a la felicidad.

programme.title: Un trabajo embarazoso
programme.desc: Thea (Lindsay Lohan), una joven ejecutiva, finge estar embarazada para evitar que su empresa la despida.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: La Coartada
programme.desc: Ray Elliott tiene un trabajo muy especial: se dedica a encubrir las relaciones matrimoniales de sus clientes.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Negocios con resaca
programme.desc: Desmadre de comedia gamberra y transgresora con Vince Vaughn como el sufrido dueño de un pequeño negocio quien, junto con sus dos socios, viajan a Europa para cerrar el acuerdo más importante de sus vidas. Pero lo que comenzó como un viaje de negocios de rutina descarrila en inimaginables caminos.

programme.title: Amor y otras drogas
programme.desc: Maggie es una mujer independiente que no deja que nada le ate. Pero conoce a Jamie, cuyo encanto le sirve bien tanto con las mujeres como dentro del mundo de las farmacéuticas. La evolución que sufre su relación coge a ambos por sorpresa, al encontrarse bajo la influencia de la droga final: el amor.

programme.title: La muerte de Stalin
programme.desc: La noche del 2 de marzo de 1953 murió un hombre. Ese hombre es Josef Stalin, dictador, tirano, carnicero y Secretario General de la URSS. Y si juegas bien tus cartas, el puesto ahora puede ser tuyo.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack es un agente literario con una exitosa trayectoria profesional. De repente su vida da un vuelco: se entera de que su mujer lo engaña con su mejor cliente, le roban en su casa y le dan una paliza.

programme.title: Una Novata en un Cuento de Hadas
programme.desc: La historia de Blancanieves se adapta a los tiempos modernos, con estudiantes de primero en una universidad con hermandades.

programme.title: Locos De Remate
programme.desc: Richard Pryor y Gene Wilder protagonizan en una desopilante comedia sobre dos convictos que intentan por todos los medios de escapar de la cárcel.

programme.title: Bad Teacher
programme.desc: Cuando su prometido la deja, una profesora de instituto malhablada, grosera e irresponsable pone sus ojos en un rico y guapo compañero de trabajo, algo que la enfrenta a una profesora modélica.

programme.title: La Pareja Del Año
programme.desc: Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) y Eddie (John Cusack) son AMERICA'S SWEETHEARTS: la pareja favorita del país, dentro y fuera de la pantalla. Pero cuando su romance se convierte en una ruptura, solo el veterano agente de prensa Lee (Billy Crystal) y la ayudante de Gwen, Kiki (Julia Roberts), pueden ayudar a Gwen y Eddie a demostrar algo de amor mientras promocionan su última película juntos.

programme.title: Más allá de la ley
programme.desc: Un trío de ladrones conspira para robar el cargamento de plata de un pueblo, pero un giro de los acontecimientos los convierte en los héroes del pueblo.

programme.title: A flechas y fuego
programme.desc: El Príncipe del Petróleo, un estafador sin escrúpulos, vende al banco unos inexistentes pozos de petróleo y desvía a unos colonos para favorecer sus planes. Sin embargo, su fraude se ve amenazado cuando Winnetou y su hermano de sangre, Old Surehand, intervienen para proteger a los inocentes y desenmascarar la conspiración.

programme.title: El ángel y el pistolero
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un malvado en toda regla, es atendido y buscado por Penelope Worth, una chica cuáquera. Al final se ve obligado a elegir entre su mundo y el de Penelope.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Río Grande
programme.desc: Un vagabundo regresa a un pequeño pueblo para vengar el asesinato de su esposa e hija.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Diez pasajeros de autobús quedan atrapados en un desguace tras ser sacados de la carretera por unos motoristas. Para sobrevivir deben improvisar armas y tener las agallas suficientes para defenderse de los asesinos motoristas.

programme.title: Resistencia
programme.desc: En 1944, un grupo de mujeres en un aislado pueblo galés descubre que sus maridos han desparecido misteriosamente.

programme.title: Lidice
programme.desc: Tras una pelea en un bar, un padre borracho mata a su hijo accidentalmente. Šima es condenado por asesinato y enviado a prisión.

programme.title: Executor
programme.desc: Un despiadado asesino, entrenado para matar en nombre de Dios por un sacerdote corrupto, reevalúa el propósito de su vida después de salvar a un niño pequeño de uno de sus propios intentos de asesinato.

programme.title: Cazador Blanco
programme.desc: Un veterano retirado que está de caza en el norte de Maine se encuentra por accidente con el cadáver de una mujer y una cuantiosa suma de dinero.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: La casa del río
programme.desc: Una enfermera de un pequeño pueblo lidera a sus vecinos de clase obrera en su lucha por salvar sus hogares frente a los intereses políticos y corporativos que quieren dar la tierra a la Pfizer Corporation.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Stillman es un joven genio despistado enamorado de Debbie. Cuando la joven decide poner fin a la relación, Stillman construirá una máquina del tiempo que le lleve de vuelta al pasado para arreglar las cosas... pero la reconciliación no sale a la primera... ni a la segunda... y como ya pasaba en “El día de la marmota”, Stillman se verá abocado a repetir una y otra vez el mismo día intentando ser una persona mejor y que Debbie no le deje. Para ello contará con la ayuda de su amigo Evan.

programme.title: Anita no pierde el tren
programme.desc: Anita ve como derriban el cine en el que trabaja como taquillera. A partir de ese día su vida cambia.

programme.title: El apóstata
programme.desc: Premio FIPRESCI del Festival de San Sebastián 2015. "El apóstata" es una comedia dramática que repasa las cicatrices de un joven que desea emanciparse de aquello que se escapa de su control, a la vez que dispara contra sí mismo y con un afán cínico en algunas cuestiones de fe, de culpa y de deseo.

programme.title: Capa Caída
programme.desc: El gran superhéroe español Magno desapareció de la vida pública después de verse implicado en un escándalo de abuso a menores. Han pasado veinte años de ese suceso y un documentalista sigue la pista del héroe caído en desgracia para realizar una película sobre él.

programme.title: El Lute II: mañana seré libre
programme.desc: Eleuterio se escapa de la cárcel, se une a sus hijos y emprende un viaje con su familia evitando la cacería de la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: El desentierro
programme.desc: La repentina aparición de la joven Vera en un pueblo del levante costero provoca que Jordi decida emprender la búsqueda de su padre, al cual había dado por muerto durante 20 años.

programme.title: El caballero de las sombras
programme.desc: Todas las adolescentes del pueblo han desaparecido. Para resolver el misterio, el detective Fei se une al cazador de demonios Pu Songling, cuyos poderes le permiten invocar cadenas con forma de tentáculos con los que atrapa a los monstruos.

programme.title: Molly TV Cut
programme.desc: A girl living alone in a post apocalyptic wasteland finds herself hunted down by marauders who want her to fight in their fighting pit for their entertainment.

programme.title: Psychomania
programme.desc: A gang of young people call themselves the Living Dead. They terrorize the population from their small town. After an agreement with the devil, if they kill themselves firmly believing in it, they will survive and gain eternal life. Following their leader, they commit suicide one after the other, but things don't necessarily turn out as expected.

programme.title: Chain Letter
programme.desc: Six friends receive a mysterious chain letter via text and email from a maniac who hunts down those who delete the message. Who knew they should take the threats in the chain letter seriously or that their favorite technologies could help track and kill them? This maniacal game pits friend against friend as they try to escape the impossible. Break the chain, lose a life.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A crazed killer known as "The Bat" is on the loose in a mansion full of people.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo de operaciones encubiertas es enviado a investigar el accidente de un avión no identificado, pronto se encuentran perseguidos por sus antiguos ocupantes.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Altitud
